items.question: Do I need boxing experience?
items.answer: No. Classes are non-contact and accommodate varying degrees of Parkinson's fitness levels.

items.question: Is it safe for my stage of Parkinson's?
items.answer: Your assessment lets coaches tailor your starting level. Coaches include occupational and physical therapy professionals.

items.question: Can I watch a class first?
items.answer: Yes. Call 865-219-7660 to observe a class.

items.question: Are caregivers welcome?
items.answer: Yes. PunchWorX is a supportive community for fighters and caregivers.

items.question: What is the facility fee?
items.answer: Kelly Recreation Complex requires that all participants register through their front desk. In doing so, they charge their own facility/usage fee to participate in our class. If a participant has an insurance wellness benefit such as Silver Sneakers or Renew Active, insurance should cover the Kelly Recreation Complex facility/usage fee and you would only need to scan in at the front desk. If a participant does not have this option available through their insurance company, Kelly Recreation Complex charges a $5.00 fee per class or ask about their discounted facility fee using activity pass. Please note, this money is collected by Kelly Recreation Complex as a separate fee, and does not replace or modify the PunchWorX, Inc. program fee.

items.question: What should I bring?
items.answer: Comfortable clothes, sneakers, and water. Gloves come with your assessment.
